name: APP — Prensa PUCMM — Boletín interno
description: Coordina el boletín diario de Prensa por SMTP a las 10:00 de lunes a viernes usando exclusivamente el día calendario anterior; el mensual tiene un coordinador separado que reutiliza el mismo orquestador.

parameters.jsCode: const zone='America/Santo_Domingo';const manual=$execution.mode==='manual'&&!$json.referenceNow&&!$json.windowStart&&!$json.windowEndExclusive;const testNow='2026-08-20T23:00:00-04:00';const testStart='2026-08-19T00:00:00-04:00';const testEnd='2026-08-20T00:00:00-04:00';const now=manual?new Date(testNow):$json.referenceNow?new Date($json.referenceNow):new Date();if(Number.isNaN(now.valueOf()))throw new Error('referenceNow inválido');const p=Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:zone,year:'numeric',month:'numeric',day:'numeric'}).formatToParts(now).map(x=>[x.type,x.value]));const calendarEnd=new Date(Date.UTC(+p.year,+p.month-1,+p.day,4));const start=manual?new Date(testStart):$json.windowStart?new Date($json.windowStart):new Date(calendarEnd.valueOf()-86400000);const end=manual?new Date(testEnd):$json.windowEndExclusive?new Date($json.windowEndExclusive):calendarEnd;if(Number.isNaN(start.valueOf())||Number.isNaN(end.valueOf())||start>=end)throw new Error('Ventana inválida');return [{json:{referenceNow:now.toISOString(),windowStart:start.toISOString(),windowEndExclusive:end.toISOString(),recipientGroup:'internal-community',digestType:'daily',emailTransport:'smtp',testMode:manual,developmentMode:manual,forceResend:manual,windowSource:manual?'fixed_test_2026-08-19':'previous_calendar_day'}}];
